errors.evidence: The description incorrectly treats the inner and outer rings as having different sets of categories. In reality, both rings show the same 14 categories, but for two different years (2014 and 2021). The description splits the categories between the two rings, which is a fundamental misinterpretation of the chart's structure.
The chart displays 14 distinct categories/segments, not 16.
The segment for 'Kultur' is blue, not light brown.
The value for 'Kultur' in the inner ring (2014) is 2.4%, not 2.2%. The description uses the value for the outer ring (2021).
The value for 'Übrige' in the inner ring (2014) is 31.1%, not 38.1%. The description uses the value for the outer ring (2021).
The value for 'Kliniken' in the inner ring (2014) is 4.5%, not 3.2%. The description uses the value for the outer ring (2021).
The value for 'Wirtschaftsförderung' in the inner ring (2014) is 6.2%, not 4.7%. The description uses the value for the outer ring (2021).
The value for 'Verkehr' in the inner ring (2014) is 4.4%, not 3.7%. The description uses the value for the outer ring (2021).
The segment for 'Übrige Versorgung' is purple, not dark brown.
The value for 'Übrige Versorgung' in the inner ring (2014) is 1.4%, not 1.3%. The description uses the value for the outer ring (2021).
The segment for 'Kombinierte Versorgung' is light purple/pink, not black. The black segment corresponds to 'Gasversorgung'.
The segment for 'Wohnungswesen' is light green, not blue.
The segment for 'Gasversorgung' is black, not dark green.
The value for 'Kombinierte Versorgung' in the outer ring (2021) is 5.5%, not 11.8%. The description seems to have taken the value for 'Wasserversorgung' from the inner ring (11.8%).
The description hallucinates categories named after numerical values. These numbers ('4,4', '1,4', '6,2') are the percentage values for other categories in the inner ring, not categories themselves.
